name: MACW Great American Heavyweight Title
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling territory, attested for 4 reigns in its own record. The territory's own record states this title was rebranded as the MACW World Title with Zero Dragon still champion, on 7 August 2023; no further reigns survive under either name, and its final reign is later cited as one of two titles unified into the MACW UDC Title.

name: MACW UDC Title
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling territory, attested for 2 reigns in its own record. Its first reign unified the Great American Heavyweight Title (by then renamed the MACW World Title) with a second title held by a wrestler billed under the same name as the Georgia Elite Wrestling territory's own Doom-Head.

name: MACW Bunk House Champion
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling territory, attested for 7 reigns in its own record.

name: MACW Great American Tag Team Titles
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling territory, attested for 5 reigns in its own record. Its final reign is recorded on the Georgia Elite Wrestling territory's own record as won by the End of Days in a unification match, forming the GEW-recorded Unified Tag Team Titles.

name: RMW National Title
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Rocky Mountain Wrestling territory, attested for 4 reigns in its own record. Generated as a spin-off from the AAWF Network Title in 2021; its record notes the title was later rebranded as the Summit Championship, with no further reigns surviving under the new name.

name: RMW National Tag Team Titles
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Rocky Mountain Wrestling territory, attested for 9 reigns in its own record. Generated as a spin-off from the AAWF Network Tag Team Titles in 2021; its final reign ended in a unification loss to a Calgary Stampede Wrestling team, and the unified title continued in that territory's own record as the Can-Am Tag Champions.

name: CSW Canadian Pride Title
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Calgary Stampede Wrestling territory, attested for 4 reigns in its own record. Continues the Georgia Elite Wrestling territory's own Canadian Pride Title after it transferred to Calgary Stampede Wrestling; the record states the title was vacated due to inactivity and rebranded as the Northern Star Champion.

name: CSW Northern Star Champion
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Calgary Stampede Wrestling territory, attested for 4 reigns in its own record. The rebranded continuation of the CSW Canadian Pride Title.

name: CSW Canadian Pride Tag Team Titles
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Calgary Stampede Wrestling territory, attested for 2 reigns in its own record. The record states the titles were vacated due to inactivity and rebranded; no further reigns survive under either name.

name: CSW Can-Am Tag Champions
epitaph: A championship of the alliance's own Calgary Stampede Wrestling territory, attested for 2 reigns in its own record. Formed when Rocky Mountain Wrestling's own National Tag Team Titles were unified into this territory's record by its first champions' win.
